description: Search the user's own LinkedIn connections by name, company, or job title. Use this to answer questions like 'who do I know at Stripe?', 'which of my connections are founders?', or to look someone up by name. Returns matching people with their company, title, headline and location. Omit all filters to list the most recent connections. On a miss the response also reports how many connections the user has imported at all: if no_imported_data is set, their connections are simply not loaded — say that, and never conclude from an empty result that they don't know the person.

query.description: Match against the person's full name.

title.description: Match against the person's job title.

name: search_connections
